label: AAP: employers can’t cold-contact MBA1s
description: Academic Adjustment Period. Employers may not cold-contact first-years. The policy page says it ends Oct 29, but the Recruiting Calendar says noon on Oct 28.

label: Autumn classes begin
description: First day of autumn quarter for all GSB students (MBA1 instruction began Sep 10) and for Stanford as a whole.

label: MBA1 exams: no recruiting
description: Exam period at the end of the AAP. The Recruiting Calendar marks it as no recruiting activity.

label: MBA1 employer events open
description: Employer events for first-years may start, and MBA1 resumes become available. Employers may communicate with and market to first-years after noon.

label: CMC internship networking event
description: CMC multi-employer internship networking event, on campus, 12 to 1:30 pm.

label: No employer events
description: No employer events from Thanksgiving week through Jan 6. CMC-managed interviews in early January still go ahead.

label: No recruiting events or interviews
description: Dead week, autumn finals and winter break. The Recruiting Calendar marks it as no recruiting activity, and holding events or interviews then breaks policy. Applications are still due inside this window (latest OCI deadline Dec 4).

label: Last OCI application deadline
description: Latest application deadline for internship on-campus and CMC-managed interviews.

label: OCI interview invitations due
description: Employers must send invitations for internship CMC-managed interviews (OCI) by this date.

label: Winter classes begin
description: First day of winter quarter classes.

label: Internship interviews, week 1 (consulting, finance)
description: Dedicated internship OCI week for consulting and finance. It falls inside the events blackout, which bans events, not interviews.

label: Internship interviews, week 3
description: Third week of internship interviews. No interviews on MLK Monday (Jan 18); Wednesday Jan 20 runs a Monday class schedule.

label: Internship offers must stay open until
description: MBA1 internship offers must stay fully open until Jan 29, 2027, or two weeks after the written offer, whichever is later.

label: Winter networking event
description: Growth Company networking event, on campus, 6 to 7 pm.

label: Winter finals and spring recess: no recruiting
description: No recruiting activity during winter finals and spring recess. The Recruiting Calendar runs this to Apr 2, though GSB spring classes start Apr 1.
